# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.0 Wave 8 Worker 3 Slot 98: Americas Three Indigenous Empires & Nova Elysia Bidirectional Synergy (oe_amr_, 0 vanilla/GUI/DLC overrides). Generated by gen_v130_americas.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Fallback for Grand Cap Slot 98 when the scheduler host (BYZ) is absent, plus protagonist quarterly check.
# Staggered on months 2/5/8/11 (offset from Slot 97 1/4/7/10); deduplicated via global_var:oe_amr_ran_m.
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_amr_fallback_pulse
		oe_amr_country_quarterly
	}
}

oe_amr_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_amr_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			current_month = 2
			current_month = 5
			current_month = 8
			current_month = 11
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_init }
		}
		OR = {
			AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } tag = VEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } tag = GEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } tag = CHI }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } tag = MNG }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } NOT = { country_exists = c:MNG } tag = TUR }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_amr_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}

oe_amr_country_quarterly = {
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_month = 2
			current_month = 5
			current_month = 8
			current_month = 11
		}
		oe_amr_is_protagonist = yes
		oe_amr_country_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		oe_amr_country_tick = yes
	}
}
